text: classic, long lasting design. This is such a nice, classic design.  My daughter chose this and purchased for her christmas gift, two sets. product_metadata.title: Lenox Portola, 3.40 LB, 20-Piece Flatware Set, Gold
description: The same classic Portola flatware that you know and love, now in a gold satin finish.
